iface.description: The network interface to monitor (e.g., eth0, ens33).

log_file.description: Path to the log file where nfswatch writes interval entries.

snap_file.description: Path to the file where snapshots are saved.

dest_host.description: Monitor packets destined for this specific host instead of the local host.

source_host.description: Restrict counting to packets sent by this specific source host.

server_host.description: Restrict counting to traffic to or from this specific NFS server.

all_traffic.description: Monitor all NFS traffic on the network (use with -all).

device.description: Specific network device to read packets from. Overrides iface.

all_interfaces.description: Read packets from all configured network interfaces.

file_list.description: Path to a file containing a list of files to monitor individually.

map_file.description: Path to a mapfile for translating device names to filesystem names.

max_time.description: Terminate execution after this many seconds (0 means no limit).

interval.description: Cycle time (interval length) in seconds between updates.

show_fs.description: Display filesystem NFS monitoring data instead of individual file data.

show_if.description: Display individual file NFS monitoring data instead of filesystem data.

auth_stats.description: Display statistics on authentication packets (by user).

procs_stats.description: Display statistics on NFS procedures (RPC calls).

procs3_stats.description: Display statistics on NFS v3 procedures (RPC calls).

client_stats.description: Display statistics on NFS client operation rates.

usage_sort.description: Sort display in declining order of percent usage.

start_log.description: Turn logging on at startup time.

background.description: Start as a daemon running in the background.

extra_flags.description: List of additional command-line flags not covered by specific variables.
